mentions.name: Bookspace
mentions.description: A simple direct booking link for hospitality businesses, letting them take bookings directly from customers who already have demand instead of paying marketplace booking fees.
mentions.problem: Hospitality businesses lose revenue to marketplace booking fees.
mentions.audience: Hospitality businesses (e.g., hotels, rentals) that already have demand for direct bookings.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building a simple direct booking link for hospitality businesses that already have demand and want to avoid marketplace booking fees.

evidence.value: I’m building a simple direct booking link for hospitality businesses that already have demand and want to avoid marketplace booking fees.
